name: Activity Model v1
purpose: Define reusable practice types that convert Can-Do targets and detected gaps into observable English use.
principles: Every activity serves a Can-Do or an identified recovery gap.
Production and comprehension are both required; grammar drills are supporting activities.
Activities should move from support to independent production.
Important errors lead to a retry of the original communicative task.
Spanish may scaffold explanation, but target-language production remains in English.
Activities should use the learner's real contexts whenever practical.

activityTypes.purpose: Notice or identify language needed for an upcoming task.
Practice a language resource with limited choices before freer use.
Understand gist, details, intention or key information in spoken English.
Understand functional, personal or professional written English.
Produce English with prompts, models or useful language support.
Produce English independently to demonstrate a Can-Do.
Respond, ask follow-up questions, clarify, repair, suggest or negotiate meaning.
Practice the identified gap and immediately retry the failed communicative task.
Improve intelligibility, stress, rhythm or intonation in meaningful language.
Combine comprehension and production around one realistic situation.

selectionRules.failedCanDo: Prefer repair-retry after targeted recovery practice.
selectionRules.resourceGap: Prefer recognition or controlled-practice before guided production.
selectionRules.listeningCanDo: Prefer listening-comprehension followed by a short response when appropriate.
selectionRules.readingCanDo: Prefer reading-comprehension followed by a meaningful response when appropriate.
selectionRules.writingCanDo: Prefer guided or independent production, including written interaction.
selectionRules.pronunciationGap: Prefer pronunciation activity embedded in the target phrase or task.
selectionRules.transfer: Prefer integrated-task or interaction in a new familiar context.

evidence.principle: Activity completion is not mastery. Evidence must be attached to the relevant Can-Do.
evidence.minimum: Every assessment activity must produce observable evidence or a meaningful learner response.
